description: This Java class 'ImageWorker' handles asynchronous image loading, caching, and display in Android applications. It manages background processing of bitmaps, memory/disk cache integration, placeholder images, and fade-in effects for images loaded into ImageViews.

classes.name: ImageWorker
classes.description: Abstract class for asynchronous image loading with caching, placeholder handling, and fade-in effects in Android.

classes.name: AsyncDrawable
classes.description: Custom Drawable that holds a reference to the background image loading task, used to manage ongoing work.

classes.name: BitmapWorkerTask
classes.description: AsyncTask subclass that performs background bitmap processing and associates the result with an ImageView.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Loads an image into an ImageView asynchronously, using cache if available, or processing in background.

methods.name: setLoadingImage
methods.description: Sets a placeholder image to display while the actual image loads.

methods.name: addImageCache
methods.description: Adds disk and memory cache to the ImageWorker for caching bitmaps.

methods.name: setImageFadeIn
methods.description: Enables or disables fade-in animation when images are loaded.

methods.name: setExitTasksEarly
methods.description: Signals ongoing tasks to exit early, useful during list scrolling.

methods.name: cancelWork
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing work associated with a specific ImageView.

methods.name: cancelPotentialWork
methods.description: Checks and cancels work if a different image is to be loaded into an ImageView.
